item.case_name: Branded explainer, 15 s, 16:9, logo and two colours
item.title: How a heat pump works

turns.text:
Make a 15-second 16:9 explainer video for my company, Acme Heat Pumps. We sell heat pumps. Explain how one works.

Use a voice-over, and show captions that match it. Use our two colours, #0E7C86 and #F28C28. End on the attached logo, unchanged, for the last 2 seconds. Give me one finished video file.

item.nudge: Make as much of this as you can with the tools you have, and give me the closest thing to one finished file.
item.tests: Tests filling a gap with correct facts, a generated voice-over, captions that match it, an unaltered logo, the brand colours and pacing.

answer_sheet.Company: Acme Heat Pumps; we sell heat pumps.
answer_sheet.Content: Explain how a heat pump works; write the voice-over yourself, with correct facts only.
answer_sheet.Voice and captions: A voice-over, with captions on screen that match it.
answer_sheet.Ending: The attached logo, unchanged, for the last 2 seconds.
answer_sheet.Format and duration: One 15-second 16:9 video; free-tier resolution is fine.

must_haves: One playable 16:9 video file runs for 15 seconds, plus or minus 1 second.
A voice-over explains how a heat pump works with correct facts and no invented claims.
The video uses the two brand colours, #0E7C86 and #F28C28.
The last 2 seconds show the attached logo, unchanged.

turns.text:

dialog.agent:
I couldn’t generate the video because your connected Magic Hour account has **0 credits**. No video was created.

The planned 15-second video includes:
- A heat-pump explanation with voice-over and matching captions
- Teal and orange animated diagrams
- Your unchanged logo held for the final 2 seconds
- One finished 16:9 video file

The workflow estimates **672 credits** at free-plan-compatible 480p settings. Add credits to your Magic Hour account, then ask me to continue.

turns.agent:
I tried the **zero-credit text-card option**, but Magic Hour blocked that too because the account has 0 credits. I couldn’t create a finished file.

Here’s the complete fallback edit, ready to assemble into one **15-second, 16:9 video**:

| Time | Visual | On-screen explanation |
|---|---|---|
| 0–4s | White text on teal **#0E7C86** | Heat pumps move heat instead of making it. |
| 4–9s | White text on orange **#F28C28** | Refrigerant absorbs warmth from outside air. A compressor raises its temperature. |
| 9–13s | White text on teal **#0E7C86** | That heat warms your home. Then the cycle repeats. |
| 13–15s | Your original logo, centred on white | No added text; logo unchanged. |

The first three cards also form the voice-over script. **No video or audio was generated**, so I don’t have a download link to give you.
